headline: Patent applications reach record high in 2025, driven by China
summary: Worldwide patent applications reached a record in 2025, according to a UN intellectual property agency report. China accounted for more than half of the increase.
why: Patent activity is a leading indicator of innovation and R&D intensity, which shape long-term competitiveness in technology sectors.
original_headline: Solicitudes de patentes alcanzan máximo histórico en 2025, impulsadas por China
